summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste, S.A.B. de C.V. (ASUR) reporting monthly passenger traffic statistics for May 2026. The filing discloses total traffic of 5.6 million passengers, a 1.6% year-over-year decrease, with regional breakdowns for Mexico, Puerto Rico, and Colombia. It contains no announcement of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or management change. The document is a standard operational update by a foreign private issuer and does not involve a material corporate event that warrants classification as a special situation.
